hooks.command:
printf '
=== Worktree-first workflow ===
Build a feature / fix a bug => work in a git worktree on a fresh branch, never in the primary checkout or on `main`.
  npm run wt:new -- <slug>   then   cd ../personal-website-worktrees/<slug>
Run `npm run check` there, push, open a PR with gh. Full workflow: docs/WORKTREE-WORKFLOW.md

Current worktrees:
'; git worktree list
